updates.text: Cain kept the punt operation clean against the controlled rush. The late interior A-gap exchange was a protection correction, not an attributed bad snap. Both snapping orders held August 1; neither snapper separated.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Jeremy Cain was a viable NFL starting long snapper who was active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and {{2013.playoffs.games:words}} playoff games for Jacksonville in 2013. His value is repeatable, accurate delivery and a routine operation, and his operation was clean through the first half of 2013 and against a controlled rush in the 2014 camp. His protection after the snap and his coverage athleticism trail his snapping.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville
Re-signed with Jacksonville for one year
Released by Jacksonville at the reduction to 53 as a vested veteran
